analysis.one_line_summary: Clean studio product render of a light pink Wavytalk hair styling brush encircled by a satin ribbon promoting a Black Friday sale of up to 35% off.
analysis.full_description: A square graphic image designed for Black Friday promotions. On the left side, bold dark text reads 'WAVYTALK' at the top, followed by 'UP TO 35% OFF' in large capital letters, and 'Black Friday' underneath. On the right side, a pastel pink Wavytalk hair styling tool (thermal straightening brush) stands upright with an active digital display showing '320°'. A flowing, glossy pink silk ribbon wraps diagonally around the tool against a bright, neutral light grey studio backdrop with soft ambient lighting and shadows.
